title: Discovery of novel bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4-BD1) inhibitors combined with 3d-QSAR, molecular docking and molecular dynamics in silico.
authors: Liu, Rong; Chen, Xiaodie; Li, Jiali; Liu, Xingyun; Shu, Mao
one_liner_zh: 该文用3D-QSAR、分子对接和MD研究BRD4-BD1小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-配体而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但非本课题核心体系。
abstract: Bromine-containing domain protein 4 (BRD4) plays a crucial role in regulating transcription and genome stability. Selective inhibitors of BRD4-BD1 can specifically target specific bromine domains to affect cell proliferation, apoptosis, and differentiation. In this work, 43 selective benzoazepinone BRD4-BD1 inhibitors were studied using molecular simulations and three-dimensional quantitative conformation relationships (3D-QSAR). A reliable 3D-QSAR model was established based on COMFA (Q2 = 0.532, R2 = 0.981) and COMSIA (S + E + H (Q2 = 0.536, R2 = 0.979) two different analysis methods. Through 3D-QSAR model prediction and quantum chemical analysis, 15 small molecules with stronger inhibitory activity than the template compounds were constructed, and 5 new compounds with higher predictive activity and binding affinity were screened by molecular docking and ADMET methods. According to the molecular dynamics simulation, the key residues that can interact with BRD4-BD1 protein and molecular docking results are consistent, including ASN140, MET132, GLN85, MET105, ASN135 and TYR97. From the MD trajectory, we calculated and analyzed RMSD, RMSF, free binding energy, FECM, DCCM and PCA, the loop region formed by amino acids VAL45 approximately PRO62 showed alpha-helix, beta-folding and clustering towards the active center with the extension of simulation time. Further optimization of the structure of active candidate compounds A6, A11, A14, and A15 will provide the necessary theoretical basis for the synthesis and activity evaluation of novel BRD4-BD1 inhibitors.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）在调控转录和基因组稳定性中发挥关键作用。BRD4-BD1的选择性抑制剂可特异性靶向特定溴结构域，从而影响细胞增殖、凋亡和分化。本研究利用分子模拟和三维定量构效关系（3D-QSAR）对43种选择性苯并氮杂卓酮类BRD4-BD1抑制剂进行了研究。基于COMFA（Q2 = 0.532，R2 = 0.981）和COMSIA（S + E + H（Q2 = 0.536，R2 = 0.979）两种不同分析方法，建立了可靠的3D-QSAR模型。通过3D-QSAR模型预测和量子化学分析，构建了15种抑制活性强于模板化合物的小分子，并通过分子对接和ADMET方法筛选出5种具有较高预测活性和结合亲和力的新化合物。根据分子动力学模拟，能与BRD4-BD1蛋白相互作用的关键残基与分子对接结果一致，包括ASN140、MET132、GLN85、MET105、ASN135和TYR97。从MD轨迹中，我们计算并分析了RMSD、RMSF、自由结合能、FECM、DCCM和PCA，由氨基酸VAL45至PRO62形成的环区随着模拟时间的延长表现出α-螺旋、β-折叠并向活性中心聚集的趋势。对活性候选化合物A6、A11、A14和A15结构的进一步优化将为新型BRD4-BD1抑制剂的合成和活性评价提供必要的理论基础。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
